multiple.description: Whether uploading multiple files is permitted

:data.description: Additions options of request. Support `Awaitable` data and `Function` since v2.3.13
:data.description_zh: 上传时附带的额外参数

with-credentials.description_zh: 支持发送 cookie 凭证信息

show-file-list.description: Whether to show the uploaded file list
show-file-list.description_zh: 是否显示已上传文件列表

drag.description: Whether to activate drag and drop mode

accept.description: Accepted file types, will not work when thumbnail-mode is true
accept.description_zh: 接受上传的文件类型（thumbnail-mode 模式下此参数无效）

:on-preview.description: Hook function when clicking the uploaded files
:on-preview.description_zh: 点击文件列表中已上传的文件时的钩子

:on-remove.description: Hook function when files are removed
:on-remove.description_zh: 文件列表移除文件时的钩子

:on-success.type: function(response: any, uploadFile: UploadFile, uploadFiles: UploadFiles)
:on-success.description_zh: 文件上传成功时的钩子

:on-error.description: Hook function when some errors occurs
:on-error.type: function(error: Error, uploadFile: UploadFile, uploadFiles: UploadFiles)
:on-error.description_zh: 文件上传失败时的钩子

:on-progress.description: Hook function when some progress occurs
:on-progress.type: function(evt: UploadProgressEvent, uploadFile: UploadFile, uploadFiles: UploadFiles)

:on-change.description: Hook function when select file or upload file success or upload file fail
:on-change.description_zh: 文件状态改变时的钩子，添加文件、上传成功和上传失败时都会被调用

:on-exceed.description: Hook function when limit is exceeded
:on-exceed.description_zh: 文件超出个数限制时的钩子

:before-upload.description: Hook function before uploading with the file to be uploaded as its parameter. If false is returned or a Promise is returned and then is rejected, uploading will be aborted
:before-upload.type: function(rawFile: UploadRawFile) => Awaitable<void | undefined | null | boolean | File | Blob>
:before-upload.description_zh: 上传文件之前的钩子，参数为上传的文件，若返回 false 或者返回 Promise 且被 reject，则停止上传

:before-remove.description: Hook function before removing a file with the file and file list as its parameters. If false is returned or a Promise is returned and then is rejected, removing will be aborted
:before-remove.description_zh: 删除文件之前的钩子，参数为上传的文件和文件列表，若返回 false 或者返回 Promise 且被 reject，则停止删除

auto-upload.description_zh: 是否在选取文件后立即进行上传

:http-request.description: Override default xhr behavior, allowing you to implement your own upload-file's request
:http-request.description_zh: 覆盖默认的上传行为，可以自定义上传的实现

slots.name: trigger
slots.description_zh: 触发文件选择框的内容

exposed.name: clearFiles
exposed.description: Clear the file list (this method is not supported in the before-upload hook)
exposed.description_zh: 清空已上传的文件列表（该方法不支持在 before-upload 中调用）
